test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:
Of the two proposals, the second one was far ___ to implement with the available resources.
solution:
The correct answer is '**better**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence compares two proposals, which necessitates the use of the **comparative adjective**.
 
• In English grammar, **"better"** is the comparative form of the adjective **"good."**
 
• **Option 2: "best"** is incorrect because "best" is the superlative form, which is used when comparing three or more items.
 
• **Option 3: "good"** is incorrect because it is the base form and does not indicate comparison.
 
• **Option 4: "more better"** is incorrect because it is grammatically redundant; "better" already indicates comparison, so "more" is unnecessary.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Of the two proposals, the second one was far **better**__ to implement with the available resources."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative adjectives** are used when comparing two entities (e.g., "better" for two proposals).
 
• **Superlative adjectives** are used when comparing three or more entities (e.g., "best" for many proposals).
 
• Avoid using redundant forms like "more better" or "most best" as they are grammatically incorrect.
